company.name: Go1
company.shortDescription: GO1 allows companies to upscale their workforce with on-demand training and a dynamic content-driven platform.
company.description: GO1 provides a platform that allows companies to upscale their workforce with on-demand training and a dynamic content-driven platform for companies that are Open to Learn. The funding follows an integration with Microsoft Teams, which enables organizations using Teams to learn directly within their workplace ecosystem. Individuals can now find, consume, share, and discuss learning resources from its library of online learning resources.

productsAndServices.description: A cloud-based learning and development platform for managing employee training, content discovery, learner access, and organizational learning programs.

productsAndServices.name: Go1 Content Curation

productsAndServices.description: Learning analytics capabilities for monitoring course participation, completions, engagement, and progress across an organization’s training programs.
productsAndServices.name: Go1 Reporting & Insights

productsAndServices.description: Employee-facing learning features that support course discovery, personalized access, self-enrollment, and training completion across web and integrated workplace environments.
productsAndServices.name: Go1 Learner Experience

productsAndServices.description: Integration capabilities that connect Go1 learning content and activity with LMS, HRIS, and other workplace technologies, including embedded learning and reporting workflows.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Venture round round raised $30,000,000, or 7.46% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $3,728,066 to $2,373,253,031, a 636.59x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 52 (-1 over 90 days) and market heat at 61 (+5).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.

insights.title: Competitive benchmark reflects the modeled peer set

insights.implication: These matches provide a starting point for comparing differentiation, scale, and shared specialties, but they should not be treated as a verified competitor set.
